headline: Sabres place Konsta Helenius on injured reserve, activate Alex Lyon
take: The Sabres activated Alex Lyon from injured reserve and moved Konsta Helenius there, Daily Faceoff reports. Lyon had been out since a shoulder injury in a September preseason game, and his return is the part that matters for the standings. Buffalo is 8-7-4 with a dead-even chance share (49.8% of the expected goals), yet it has allowed 5.07 more goals than the chances against it deserved. That gap is mostly goaltending, and it's the kind a healthy extra goalie can help close. Helenius has three points in 11 games at about 13 minutes a night; the Sabres have broken even at five on five with him out there (51% of expected goals), so his absence costs depth more than offence.
